latin: Qui praecedentis conclusionis opus attentauerit, adhibeat opus cabalae secundum appropriata timori Isaac.
translation: One who undertakes the operation of the preceding conclusion must join to it a work of Cabala drawn from what is assigned to the fear of Isaac.
